item.title: Dawson Creek agricultural land owner loses pipeline permit appeal
item.description: The Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal has rejected a Dawson Creek land owner’s application to overturn a permit issued by the BCER to Vermilion Energy.

item.title: Prosecutor outlines case against three accused in brutal slaying of B.C. couple
item.description: A Crown prosecutor says a large body of circumstantial evidence has established the case of first-degree murder against three young men on trial for the violent slaying of a couple. One of the defendents arrived on student visa to study in Dawson Creek.

item.title: Man who admitted manslaughter in Fort St. John seeks new counsel ahead of sentencing
item.description: Katlin Cota, who pleaded guilty to manslaughter after a person died in Fort St. John in June 2025, is looking for new counsel ahead of his sentencing.

item.title: Toxicologist sees no drug link to Myles Gray’s behaviour before police-involved death
item.description: VANCOUVER — A forensic expert has told a hearing into the 2015 police-involved death of Myles Gray that not much could be concluded from a toxicology report regarding his behaviour, that Vancouver officers have previously described as “animalistic” and “superhuman.” Toxicologist Dr. Aaron Shapiro with B.C.’s Provincial Toxicology Centre told the hearing Friday the results […]

item.title: B.C. approves new police training sites in Vancouver and Victoria
item.description: VICTORIA — Two new police training sites have been approved in Vancouver and Victoria to address a surge in demand for recruits from communities across British Columbia. The B.C. government says the sites will initially operate for two years and be fully funded by participating police forces. The facilities will operate under the oversight of […]

item.title: Hudson’s Hope Health Centre temporarily closes again due to short staffing
item.description: The Hudson's Hope Health Centre has been closed temporarily on March 6th and will reopen on March 9th at 8.30 a.m.

item.title: Organizers of second Cultural Gathering of Nations seek sponsorship from Dawson Creek council
item.description: The organizers behind the Cultural Gathering of Nations at the Ovintiv Events Centre have sought sponsorship from the City of Dawson Creek.

item.title: Confirmed measles cases in northeast B.C. exceeds 320 in latest update
item.description: Two new confirmed measles cases have been reported by Northern Health in the week leading up to March 5th, both in the northeast region.

item.title: Energy regulator to funnel ‘significant funding and work’ into Peace orphan wells
item.description: During the PRRD’s February 26th board meeting, a delegation from the BC Energy Regulator (BCER) gave an update on plans for orphaned and dormant well sites in the Peace region.

item.title: Mother of B.C. mass shooting survivor shares update, says breathing tube removed
item.description: Maya Gebala had her breathing tube removed to see if she could breath on her own.
